text: Binary per-row check on other users' comments (OC_comments, JSON list, not the OP), using title and argument only to identify the OP's view: returns 1 if at least one single comment first redrafts the OP's viewpoint in a more nuanced, qualified, refined or charitably reformulated form, and then refutes or argues against that redrafted/OP view within the same comment. Merely quoting, summarizing without nuance, agreeing, or refuting without first restating gives no credit; separate comments cannot combine. Returns 0 if the list is valid and no comment qualifies (including a valid empty list); null if OC_comments is missing or malformed, or if both title and argument are missing so the OP view can't be identified. Ignore OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates and any outcome reports, wherever they appear (including argument); generic discussion of delta/platform rules may be kept.
